# NEMA8 TVS sample

A two-component extract from
[the real NEMA8 board, v1.0.48](https://tscircuit.com/ShiboSoftwareDev/nema8-20mm-dual-usbc-stepper-controller).

The TVS, bypass capacitor, pads and complete saved route retain their original
identifiers and geometry, including the top-to-bottom via and the incorrect
endpoint on the TVS anode. Unrelated components and metadata are omitted.

The VM source path through omitted components is collapsed to one equivalent
connection between the retained VM pins. The original ground connections remain.
This preserves the source connectivity of all four retained pins:

| Pin | Original source port | Intended net |
| --- | --- | --- |
| C_VM_HF1.pin1 | source_port_155 | VM |
| C_VM_HF1.pin2 | source_port_156 | GND |
| D_VM_TVS.pin1 (cathode) | source_port_149 | VM |
| D_VM_TVS.pin2 (anode) | source_port_150 | GND |

Eight PCB notes label the sample. The SVG snapshot is generated by the standard
PCB renderer from this same JSON, with a note showing the tested software result.
The complete board remains covered by the separate full-board regression.
